## File: facebookresearch_parlai/parlai/agents/fid/fid.py

Prompts

```
['build a FiD model that encodes multiple documents in parallel and concatenates outputs for the decoder', 'build a T5-based FiD model using T5FidModel for T5 generation architecture', 'build a Fusion in Decoder agent that extends RagAgent for retrieval-augmented generation', 'build a SearchQueryFiDAgent with a query generator model and document chunking parameters', 'concatenate encoder outputs from multiple documents per batch item for FiD-style decoding']
```

Usage

```
{'build_fid_model': 'build a FiD model that encodes multiple documents in parallel and concatenates outputs for the decoder', 'build_t5_fid_model': 'build a T5-based FiD model using T5FidModel for T5 generation architecture', 'build_fid_agent': 'build a Fusion in Decoder agent that extends RagAgent for retrieval-augmented generation', 'build_search_query_fid_agent': 'build a SearchQueryFiDAgent with a query generator model and document chunking parameters', 'concat_enc_outs': 'concatenate encoder outputs from multiple documents per batch item for FiD-style decoding'}
```
